name: Jarvis Capture Router

nodes.name: Classify (Claude)
nodes.notes: Anthropic Messages API. x-api-key uses env var ANTHROPIC_KEY. Swap the model id for the current Anthropic model at build time. The system prompt mirrors resources/classification.md — keep them in sync.

nodes.name: Route by Type
nodes.notes: Output 0 = ha_action (rule match). Output 1 = vault (fallback 'extra') for note/task/idea/journal/inbox — everything that isn't an HA command.

nodes.name: Call Home Assistant
nodes.notes: Calls HA REST /api/services/<domain>/<service>. Domain/service are split from ha_action.service (e.g. 'light.turn_on'). Body merges entity_id with ha_action.data.

nodes.name: Append to Vault (Local REST API)
nodes.notes: POST /vault/<path> APPENDS to the note via desktop Obsidian on the PC; Obsidian Sync then fans out to all devices. allowUnauthorizedCerts=true because the Local REST API plugin uses a self-signed cert on :27124 (or use http://PC:27123). Requires desktop Obsidian running with the Local REST API plugin. RECOMMENDED over the GitHub node: git + Obsidian Sync conflict and mobile git is unreliable. Fallback: wire a Filesystem node on the error output for when the PC/Obsidian is off.

_jarvis_import_notes: Import via n8n: Workflows -> ... -> Import from File. Then set env vars ANTHROPIC_KEY, HA_URL (e.g. http://192.168.0.50:8123), HA_TOKEN, OBSIDIAN_REST_URL (e.g. https://PC-IP:27124), OBSIDIAN_REST_TOKEN (Settings -> Variables, or .env if self-hosting). The vault writer uses the Obsidian Local REST API plugin running in desktop Obsidian on the PC (NOT git) — Obsidian Sync then delivers to all devices. Install + enable the plugin before importing. Node versions verified against current n8n via the n8n MCP get_node_types: webhook 2.1, httpRequest 4.4, code 2 (mode runOnceForAllItems), switch 3.4 (mode rules), respondToWebhook 1.5. The raw-body vault writer uses contentType 'raw' + specifyBody 'string' + rawContentType 'text/markdown' (n8n's raw-body shape). The Switch sends ha_action to output 0 and everything else to the renamed fallback output 1 ('vault'). The classifier system prompt mirrors resources/classification.md — keep them in sync. Pick the current Anthropic model id at build time. Add a Filesystem-node fallback on the Append node's error output for when the PC/Obsidian is off.
